title: 第15章 糟蹋土地第16章 百废待举
slug: 帝皇在上第699章兵临城下
lines: 平心而论，黑滩镇的地理位置实际上不算差。
这里东面临海。
耕地大多集中在地形平坦的镇西。
而往北就是连绵的山林。
那个方向距离高岭山脉最近处大约也就不到三十公里的距离。
这条山脉从东北往西南方位略微倾斜延伸，按照伯爵老爹赠送的地图标注来看，长度大约在一千八百公里左右。
这样的尺度其实跟秦岭差不多。
在地图上它的名称是——
——寒霜坚壁！
这条山脉名副其实。
最高的那几座山峰基本都有着万米的海拔。
离黑滩镇最近的那座高峰名为“霜龙之牙”。
这个名字据说是从高岭蛮人那里直译过来的。
具体含义无法考证。
从镇内望去都能看到山峰上缭绕的白云和积雪。
对看惯了卡林城单调风景的罗德而言，这座高峰可算是有点儿异界景致该有的意思了。
寒霜坚壁为包括黑滩镇在内的大片区域阻挡了从北境涌来的寒风。
大陆的北境人迹罕至。
那里是绵延数千里纵深的广袤冻土。
生活在冻土上的是那些信仰蛮荒诸神的荒原人部族。
他们大多奉行着原始的生存法则，保留着许多野蛮且原始的传统。
至于所谓的高岭蛮族，其实就是生活在高岭山脉上的荒原人。
整条绵延的山脉上，共有大小上百个不同的氏族。
不过高岭蛮族逐渐在王国文明的影响下产生了一些变化。
这让他们跟北边的亲戚比起来有了一些差别。
黑滩镇的林场和采石场都位于北面。
但其中的采石场因为屡遭高岭蛮族袭扰在几个月前就封闭了。
提到采石场，罗德就想起了临走时父亲对他的告诫。
至于镇子的南边就乏善可陈了。
东南沿海是遍布礁石的淤泥滩涂，往南则是错落分布的防风林与河滩。
另外还有若干条河流分支从西边延伸而来，逐渐向东南入海。
镇子本身就处在一个相对避风的位置。
有海、有山、有林子有空地。
还要什么自行车？
众人很快抵达黑滩镇西的田地。
秋收已在一周前结束。
目前田间还种植着一些豆类。
具体亩数不明，估摸着不少于五百亩。
如今已濒临成熟

;;
To be fair, the location of Black Beach Town is actually not bad.
It faces the sea to the east.
Most of the cultivated land is concentrated in the west of the town where the terrain is flat.
To the north is the continuous mountain forest.
That direction is about less than thirty kilometers away from the nearest point of the Gaoling Mountains.
This mountain range extends slightly tilted from northeast to southwest. According to the map mark given by the Earl's father, the length is about 1,800 kilometers.
This scale is actually similar to the Qinling Mountains.
Its name on the map is -
——The frosty wall!
This mountain range lives up to its name.
The highest peaks are basically 10,000 meters above sea level.
The peak closest to Black Beach Town is called "Frost Dragon's Tooth".
This name is said to be a literal translation from the Gaoling barbarians.
The specific meaning cannot be verified.
From the town, you can see the white clouds and snow on the mountain peaks.
For Rhodes, who was used to seeing the monotonous scenery of Carlin City, this peak was a bit like an alien scene.
The frost wall blocks the cold wind from the north for a large area including Black Beach Town.
The northern part of the mainland is sparsely populated.
There is a vast frozen soil that stretches thousands of miles in depth.
Living on the frozen soil are the tribes of wilderness people who believe in wild gods.
Most of them follow primitive survival laws and retain many barbaric and primitive traditions.
As for the so-called Gaoling barbarians, they are actually wilderness people living on the Gaoling Mountains.
There are hundreds of different clans in the entire stretching mountain range.
However, the Kaoling barbarians gradually underwent some changes under the influence of the kingdom's civilization.
This makes them somewhat different from their relatives in the north.
The forest farms and quarries of Black Beach Town are located to the north.
However, one of the quarries was closed a few months ago due to repeated attacks by Gaoling barbarians.
When Rhodes mentioned the quarry, he remembered his father's warning to him before leaving.
As for the south side of town, it's lackluster.
The southeastern coast is covered with silt tidal flats dotted with reefs, while to the south are scattered windbreaks and river beaches.
There are also several river branches extending from the west and gradually entering the sea to the southeast.
The town itself is in a relatively sheltered position.
There are seas, mountains, woods and open spaces.
What kind of bike do you want?
Everyone quickly arrived at the fields west of Black Beach Town.
The autumn harvest ended a week ago.
There are still some beans growing in the fields.
The exact number of acres is unknown, but it is estimated to be no less than 500 acres.
Now on the verge of maturity
